prompt:
Build a Simulink and Simscape model of an automated transfer cell containing a five-axis articulated robot arm with a commanded two-finger gripper, an input conveyor, an output conveyor, and a rigid package. Each of the five arm joints must be driven from a shared DC electrical source through a controlled H-bridge, a DC motor, and a mechanical transmission with finite friction. Measured arm-joint position must close the corresponding actuator-control loop; prescribed arm-joint motion is not an acceptable replacement for the electrical drives and robot dynamics. The two gripper fingers must have commanded and measured opening motion with finite mechanical friction and a physically coupled electrical-load estimate.

Use package-presence or light-curtain sensing to coordinate the conveyors, arm, and gripper. The cell must pick the freely moving package from the input conveyor, retain it during arm motion, release it onto the output conveyor, and move the released package away. Contact between the gripper and package must be compliant rather than a welded or signal-only attachment.

Read the following variables from the MATLAB base workspace and remain functional throughout their stated inclusive ranges: SupplyVoltage_V from 21.6 to 26.4 V (nominal 24 V), PayloadMass_kg from 0.35 to 0.50 kg (nominal 0.40 kg), JointFrictionScale from 0.8 to 1.2 (nominal 1.0), and SequenceDelayScale from 0.9 to 1.1 (nominal 1.0). Do not bypass the electrical arm drives, transmissions, arm-joint dynamics, sensing, gripper motion, or contact paths at any value in those ranges.

The evaluator runs the model from 0 s through 20 s. The complete sensing, pickup, closed-loop multi-axis arm transport, release, and output conveyance sequence must be represented in that interval. Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named joint_command, joint_position, motor_current, joint_effort, payload_pose, and sensor_state. joint_command and joint_position each have 7 channels in pivot, bicep, forearm, wrist, gripper, finger A, and finger B order; the first five use rad and the two finger channels use mm. motor_current has 7 channels in the same axis order, all in A. joint_effort has 7 channels in the same order: the first five torques in N*m and the two finger forces in N. payload_pose has 3 channels giving world-frame [x, y, z] position in metres; +z is upward. sensor_state has 4 channels in this order: input box present, input light curtain, output box present, and output light curtain.

Save the completed model as cand_XMECH10.slx in the submission directory and keep its latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMECH10.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
